sources.entry: CronAI - An AI-powered cron expression generator that converts natural language scheduling descriptions into valid cron syntax instantly.

summary.name: CronAI
summary.one_liner: A web tool that turns plain-English scheduling descriptions into 5-field cron expressions.
use_cases: Generate a cron expression without memorizing syntax
Schedule recurring jobs in Linux crontab
Set up GitHub Actions scheduled workflows
Configure Kubernetes CronJobs or Vercel Cron schedules
Convert business-hours or twice-daily schedules into cron
summary.what_it_does: CronAI takes a plain-English description of when something should run and uses AI to produce a cron expression in standard 5-field syntax. The page shows example prompts such as weekday mornings, every 5 minutes, first day of the month, and twice-daily times. The page states it works with any cron-compatible system and names Linux crontab, GitHub Actions, AWS CloudWatch, Kubernetes CronJobs, and Vercel Cron. The page describes it as a free cron expression generator. Its meta description is only the default "Generated by create next app" text, so the page offers little detail beyond the core generator.
notable: Plain-English input converted to standard 5-field cron syntax
Lists compatibility with Linux crontab, GitHub Actions, AWS CloudWatch, Kubernetes CronJobs and Vercel Cron
Listed in eudk/awesome-ai-tools under Unsorted category
caveats: Page does not describe limitations or accuracy guarantees
Page does not say how the AI model is run or what data is sent
Meta description is default Next.js placeholder text
